breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification is self-contradictory and fails to fix the inconsistency. It correctly states 'The pressure gradient points radially outward from the center of curvature', but then immediately repeats the original error by stating 'The pressure increases toward the center of curvature' and 'The pressure on the inner side is higher than the pressure on the outer side.' The ground truth corrects this by implying pressure increases outward, away from the center of curvature.
